input:
EARLIER SCENES (context only):
这个男孩子叫孟子，孟子是古代的人。孟子的妈妈觉得住在哪儿对童年很重要，所以他们常常搬了家。她望子成龙，所以孟子的妈妈安排他的生活。
CURRENT SCENE:
因为他们常常搬了家，中国人说，孟母三迁。孟子没有爸爸，所以，他的妈妈更重要。从这儿到那儿，妈妈教孟子很多技能。先她让孟子跟朋友玩儿，然后教他怎么买又便宜又好质量的东西。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P150] 因为他们常常搬【了】家
  proposed by the AI checker: 因为他们常常搬[-了]家 (habitual action with 常常 does not take 了)
  proposed by the correction model: 因为他们常常搬[-了]家
  her past correction (cause_result_soyi): [+所以]他们常常搬家 — her note: 无聊？add所以
  her past correction (numeral_measure_word_order): 他们[搬了家两次→搬了两次家] — her note: V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.
  her past correction (le_completed): 所以他们再[搬家一次→搬了一次家] — her note: 了completed
  rule card cause_result_soyi: Use 所以 only when the clause before it gives the cause/reason and the clause after it is the result. If there is no cause-result relationship, delete 所以 or use a connector such as 这样, 后来, or 结果 when appropriate. Not an error: Do not flag a causal 所以 when the preceding clause genuinely causes the following result. Use 结果 for an unexpected result, and do not use 所以 for sequence (后来), manner (这样), or purpose (为了…).
  rule card numeral_measure_word_order: With a number and measure word, use Num. + MW. + noun directly, with no 的. For actions, use V. + Num. + MW. + Obj.; for a completed action, use 了completed, V. + Num. + MW. + Obj. Not an error: Do not use 们 or 些 with a number: use 三个男孩, not 三个男孩子们, and 那三个男孩, not 那些三个男孩.

[P151] 【孟母】三迁
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: ⟦孟母⟧三迁 (first appearance of 孟母: briefly introduce who this is)
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧和孟母住在一起 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧跟妈妈一起住在西安 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧和孟母住在小的城 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  rule card first_mention_introduction: When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.

[P152] 妈妈教孟子很多【技能】
  proposed by the correction model: 妈妈教孟子很多[技能→东西]
  her past correction (redundant_words): [-孟子的妈妈]告诉孟子 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 孟子的妈妈不是工作就是试一试[帮助她的儿子孟子→辅导儿子孟子]
  her past correction (not_but_refutation): 孟子的妈妈[不是轻松的妈妈，而且她是厉害的妈妈→在教育方面很厉害] — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.

[P153] 【先她】让孟子跟朋友玩儿
  proposed by the AI checker: [先她→她先]让孟子跟朋友玩儿 (the subject comes before 先)
  proposed by the correction model: 先[-她]让孟子跟朋友玩儿
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): ⟦孟子⟧不是跟朋友玩 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction (verb_reduplication_requests): 孟子老是想[玩玩→玩] — her note: V.V. is used to make requests or plans
  her past correction (redundant_words): [-孟子老是]想玩玩
  rule card first_mention_introduction: When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.
  rule card verb_reduplication_requests: Use V.V. to make a request or express a plan. Do not use V.V. simply to describe an action in a completed narrative; use the ordinary verb or the corrected completed form instead. Not an error: V.V. is appropriate when making a request or expressing a plan.

[P154] 然后教他怎么买又便宜【^】又好质量的东西
  proposed by the correction model: 然后教他怎么买又便宜[+质量]又好质量的东西
  her past correction (location_with_zai): 她跟孟子常常[去买东西在城市→去城市买东西]
  her past correction (ambiguous_pronoun): 所以[-他]看什么就吃什么 — her note: this is ambiguous, as the topic is他的朋友
  her past correction (resultative_complements): 然后写[+下了]他学了什么
  rule card location_with_zai: Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear. Not an error: Do not add 上 after every place word: 农村 is already a place, so use 在农村住, not 在农村上住.
  rule card ambiguous_pronoun: Use 他/她/它/他们 only when it is clear who or what they refer to. If more than one person or thing is possible, repeat the name or use a clear noun phrase. Not an error: A pronoun is fine when its referent is close and unambiguous. Do not use 你 for a story character when it refers to the reader instead.

[P155] 然后教他怎么买又便宜又【好质量】的东西
  proposed by the AI checker: 然后教他怎么买又便宜又[好质量→质量好]的东西 (quality adjective order is reversed)
  proposed by the correction model: 然后教他怎么买又便宜又好[-质量]的东西
  her past correction (location_with_zai): 她跟孟子常常[去买东西在城市→去城市买东西]
  her past correction (ambiguous_pronoun): 所以[-他]看什么就吃什么 — her note: this is ambiguous, as the topic is他的朋友
  her past correction (time_sequence_markers): [常常祭拜以后，→常常在祭拜以后]孟子和他的妈妈一起去买东西
  rule card location_with_zai: Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear. Not an error: Do not add 上 after every place word: 农村 is already a place, so use 在农村住, not 在农村上住.
  rule card ambiguous_pronoun: Use 他/她/它/他们 only when it is clear who or what they refer to. If more than one person or thing is possible, repeat the name or use a clear noun phrase. Not an error: A pronoun is fine when its referent is close and unambiguous. Do not use 你 for a story character when it refers to the reader instead.

孟子的妈妈 was already introduced in the earlier scene
教很多技能 is acceptable beginner Chinese
time adverb should follow the subject here
no word is missing at this position
质量好 is the natural adjective order
